entities.summary: Orlando Julius Aremu Olusanya Ekemode, known professionally as Orlando Julius or Orlando Julius Ekemode was a Nigerian saxophonist, singer, bandleader, and songwriter closely associated with afrobeat music. Orlando Julius was a composers & musicians from Ilesa (1943-09-22, Ilesa–2022-04-15). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
